sourcing: Specs sourced from Mamibot's official product page (mamibot.com/iglassbot-w120-dp) and the W120-DP's official user manual, as of September 2026. **Naming discrepancy:** robotindex could not confirm a "~WB" suffix anywhere in Mamibot's own materials, retail listings, or press coverage — every official and retail source refers to this product simply as "W120-DP" (marketed as "iGLASSBOT W120-DP"). "WB" may reflect an internal or reseller color/variant code not used publicly; specs here are for the confirmed W120-DP model. editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Unlike most window robots, the W120-DP holds to glass via air-pressure adhesion (not vacuum suction), backed by pressure and photoelectric edge sensors, a gyroscope, and anti-fall detection. Mamibot's own user manual explicitly requires tying a safety rope to an indoor fixture before use — a manual requirement, not just a marketed accessory.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Despite this listing's name, Mamibot's own site, its official user manual, and all retail/press coverage refer to this product simply as the "W120-DP" — no "~WB" suffix appears anywhere in the manufacturer's own materials. It likely reflects an internal or reseller variant code rather than a real model designation.
